faqs.q: Sec. 58-131. - Expungement of juvenile delinquent records by the municipal court.
faqs.a:
(a)
The municipal court shall expunge juvenile delinquent records in accordance with the
               provisions of C.R.S. § 13-10-115.5, as may be amended from time to time.
(b)
For purposes of this section, juvenile means a person who is ten or more years of
               age but less than 18 years of age.
(
Ord. No. 4868
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4868
, § 1, adopted March 4, 2024, repealed the former § 58-131, and enacted a new § 58-131
               as set out herein. The former § 58-131 pertained to juvenile justice records defined
               and derived from § 2-221 of the 1981 Code; Ord. No. 1905, § 1, 2-7-1983.
